item.title: Episode 1: ‘Letters to my mother’ with Kumi Naidoo
item.description: What does a person do when losing both his mother – a working-class woman – and his son – a famous rapper – through suicide? Activist Kumi Naidoo bares his soul in this podcast about his moving book, “Letters to my Mother: the making of a troublemaker”. The post Episode 1: ‘Letters to my mother’ with Kumi Naidoo appeared first on Jacana.

item.title: Episode 2: Freedom Writer – Mixtape
item.description: This podcast by journalist Charles Leonard is a celebration of the South African reporter, Juby Mayet, whose autobiography, “Freedom Writer – My Life and Times”, has just been published by Jacana Media. The post Episode 2: Freedom Writer – Mixtape appeared first on Jacana.

item.title: Episode 3: ‘Against the Ruck’ – A History of Black Rugby
item.description: ‘Rugby, Resistance and Politics’, by historian Buntu Siwisa takes us back to the roots of black rugby back in the 1820s, and tells Charles Leonard why rugby is far more popular than football in black communities of the Eastern Cape. The post Episode 3: ‘Against the Ruck’ – A History of Black Rugby appeared first on Jacana.
